section_sequence.what_it_does: Off-white bar: logo, 4 links, Get a Demo / Log In outlined and black Sign Up; below it a single centered event line with 'Get your ticket' link.

Three-column composition across the full width: two-line H1 + pill CTAs far left, large black triangle with soft glow center, three short audience lines far right; lots of empty space above and below.
Seven customer logos spaced evenly edge to edge at the bottom of the first viewport.
Scroll-driven stack of use cases (Notion, Zapier, Mintlify): headline left, live-looking product screenshot centered, stat sentence + 'Features' list right.
Bento: one tall left card with line illustration (agent framework) and two stacked right cards (Passport with black ID graphic, Containers with terminal log).
Centered 'Built by you, or your agents' with Deploy now pill and an 'Onboard your agent' copy command.
Dense 6-column sitemap in two tiers (products, then company/legal/social), small logo and a blue mono 'All systems normal' status line with theme toggles.

motion.observed: No visible change between t=0, 0.7, 1.8, 3.5 and 8s; the triangle, glow and copy stay static.
Headline, screenshot and right-hand stat swap per customer while the section stays in place; the next headline slides up as the previous screenshot scrolls off.
In desktop-full.jpg the area after Notion is a ~2000px blank gap, consistent with a pinned track whose content only renders in one state (inference).

The monospace subline reads 'To ship apps andrhkbeah' in mobile-hero.jpg and 'To ship apps and agents' in mobile-scroll.jpg: text scrambles and then resolves, cycling the three desktop lines (inferred from stills).

reduced_motion: Triangle renders flat with no soft glow/shadow and no halo circle, versus the blurred shadow in the normal hero; everything else identical. capture.json running_animations = 0 in both modes.
mobile: Nav becomes logo + two-line hamburger and stays pinned. The hero recenters into one column: announcement, big glowing triangle on top, centered two-line H1, a single scrambling monospace subline instead of the three right-column lines, then full-width stacked pill buttons. The logo strip becomes a horizontally cropped row. The customer showcase stacks headline, screenshot, stat and feature list per customer; Recently shipped goes single-column with the Passport and Containers cards angled; the footer becomes 2 columns.
adaptable_ideas: Spread a hero across three far-apart columns (claim / emblem / audience list) so whitespace, not a container, defines the composition.
On narrow screens collapse a static list of audience lines into one rotating typed line in a monospace face, keeping the idea without the width.
Customer proof as a pinned three-slot layout (headline / real product screenshot / stat + features) that swaps per customer on scroll.
End with a one-line centered CTA plus a copyable command, then a status line in the footer as a quiet credibility signal.
capture_issues: desktop-full.jpg and mobile-full.jpg both show a large blank region where the pinned customer showcase sits; the Zapier and Mintlify states appear only in the scroll strips.
The fixed nav is missing from the top of both full-page captures and is stamped over the footer instead (desktop outline y=5030).
The last recorded frames of desktop-scroll.mp4 switch to a grey panel with a small page thumbnail (appears to be the capture switching viewports, not site behaviour).
